label: SanaTA system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a sanaTA toxin-antitoxin locus represented by DefenseFinder as a SanaA/SanaT two-profile model and experimentally linked to resistance against T7 phage mutants lacking gene 4.5 anti-defense activity.
observations: SanaTA branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual SanaA or SanaT proteins, the SanaTA source key, the DefenseFinder SanaTA__SanaA and SanaTA__SanaT profiles, the extra SanaTA__SanaT_1 HMM row, T7 Gp4.5, Lon protease, gene-4.5 anti-defense activity, and other phage-defense systems.
